policy-travel-eu.title: Travel and Expense Policy (EU)
policy-travel-eu.text:
## Scope
This policy applies to employees of Quorvia Instruments B.V. in the Netherlands, Portugal and Germany.

## Meals
The meal per diem is EUR 90 per travel day and is paid without receipts. Receipts are required for every expense except the meal per diem.

## Accommodation
Hotel bookings are capped at EUR 150 per night; anything above the cap needs written approval from a director. Expenses are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the end of the trip.

## Private car
Business use of a private car is reimbursed at EUR 0.30 per kilometre.

## Booking
Flights must be booked at least 8 days before departure unless the trip is urgent. Economy class is the default for all flights.

## Approval
Trips with an estimated total cost above EUR 1500 require pre-approval from the budget owner.

policy-remote-eu.title: Remote Work Policy (EU)
policy-remote-eu.text:
## Scope
This policy applies to employees of Quorvia Instruments B.V. in the Netherlands, Portugal and Germany.

## Remote days
Employees may work remotely for up to 8 days per calendar month.

## Home office
New hires receive a one-time home office stipend of EUR 350 for a desk, chair and accessories. Remote days are agreed with the team lead at least one week ahead. Company equipment must not be used by family members.

## Internet
A monthly internet allowance of EUR 45 is paid with the salary.

## Working abroad
Working from a country other than your employment country is allowed for up to 16 days per calendar year. Employees remain reachable on chat during core collaboration hours.

policy-parental-eu.title: Parental Leave Policy (EU)
policy-parental-eu.text:
## Scope
This policy applies to employees of Quorvia Instruments B.V. in the Netherlands, Portugal and Germany.

## Primary caregiver
The primary caregiver receives 15 weeks of fully paid leave after the birth or adoption of a child.

## Secondary caregiver
The secondary caregiver receives 8 weeks of fully paid leave, to be taken within the first year. Leave requests are submitted to People Operations at least eight weeks before the expected date. Benefits and pension contributions continue during paid leave.

## Eligibility
Employees become eligible after 5 months of continuous employment.

## Return to work
After leave, a phased return at reduced hours is available for up to 9 weeks. Leave can start up to two weeks before the expected date of birth.

policy-pto-eu.title: Paid Time Off Policy (EU)
policy-pto-eu.text:
## Scope
This policy applies to employees of Quorvia Instruments B.V. in the Netherlands, Portugal and Germany.

## Annual allowance
Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid time off per calendar year.

## Carry-over
Up to 6 unused days can be carried over into the next year. Carried-over days must be used by 28 February. Time off is requested in the HR portal and approved by the team lead. Part-time employees receive paid time off pro rata.

## Sick days
Up to 10 paid sick days per year can be taken without a medical certificate.

## Volunteering
Each employee has 2 paid volunteering days per year. Public holidays follow the local calendar of the employment country.

policy-retention-eu.title: Data Retention Policy (EU)
policy-retention-eu.text:
## Scope
This policy applies to customers whose contract is with Quorvia Instruments B.V. (the Netherlands, Portugal and Germany).

## Telemetry
Raw device telemetry is retained for 240 days before it is aggregated. The Security team reviews this policy every year.

## Audit logs
Audit logs are kept for 12 months. Retention periods apply to production systems and to their backups.

## Backups
Encrypted backups are retained for 91 days.

## Deletion requests
Verified customer deletion requests are completed within 15 days. Legal holds override the retention periods below.

## Data location
Customer data for this region is stored in the Frankfurt data centre.

policy-oncall-eu.title: On-Call Compensation Policy (EU)
policy-oncall-eu.text:
## Scope
This policy applies to employees of Quorvia Instruments B.V. in the Netherlands, Portugal and Germany.

## Weekday rate
Each weekday on call is compensated with EUR 45.

## Weekend rate
Each weekend day on call is compensated with EUR 170. On-call schedules are published four weeks in advance. Time spent on incidents outside working hours is recorded as overtime.

## Response
Pages must be acknowledged within 7 minutes.

## Limits
Nobody is scheduled for more than 3 on-call weeks per quarter. Swaps are allowed when both engineers update the schedule.

Customers can return devices within 26 days of delivery for a full refund. Devices must be returned in their original packaging when possible. Refunds are paid to the original payment method.

## Shipping
Quorvia pays return shipping for orders above EUR 250. A return authorization must be requested before shipping a device back.

spec-pulse-lite.title: Quorvia Pulse Lite (QV-PU100) specification sheet
spec-pulse-lite.text:
## Overview
Pulse is the Quorvia air-quality sensor line; it measures particulate matter, CO2 and humidity indoors. The Lite model (QV-PU100) is the entry-level option of the Pulse line.

## Power
Battery life is 27 months at the default sampling interval.

## Connectivity
Radio range is up to 1700 metres in open field.

## Measurement
The default sampling interval is 45 seconds. Readings are buffered on the device for 72 hours when the gateway is offline.

## Enclosure
The enclosure is rated IP65 for dust and water.

## Environment
Operating temperature range is -35 °C to 85 °C.

## Pricing
List price is USD 199 per unit. Volume discounts are available from 50 units.

## Warranty
Hardware warranty is 2 years from delivery.

Vane is the Quorvia wind sensor line; it measures wind speed and direction on rooftops and masts. The Lite model (QV-VN100) is the entry-level option of the Vane line.

## Power
Battery life is 51 months at the default sampling interval.

## Connectivity
Radio range is up to 550 metres in open field.

## Measurement
The default sampling interval is 5 seconds. Readings are buffered on the device for 72 hours when the gateway is offline.

## Enclosure
The enclosure is rated IP54 for dust and water.

## Environment
Operating temperature range is -40 °C to 50 °C.

## Pricing
List price is USD 229 per unit. Volume discounts are available from 50 units.

## Warranty
Hardware warranty is 3 years from delivery.

sla-starter.title: Service Level Agreement: Starter tier
sla-starter.text:
## Uptime
The monthly uptime commitment for the Starter tier is 99.5%. Scheduled maintenance announced 72 hours ahead is excluded.

## Support
Priority 1 incidents on the Starter tier get a first response within 240 minutes. Support is staffed on business days from 09:00 to 17:00 CET.

## Service credits
Each 0.1% of uptime below the commitment earns a service credit of 2% of the monthly fee, capped at 30%. Credits are requested through the support portal within 30 days.

sla-team.text:

runbook-ingest-gateway.title: Runbook: ingest-gateway
runbook-ingest-gateway.text:
## Purpose
The ingest-gateway service receives telemetry uploads from devices. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the upload queue depth stays above 680 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error ING-6139 means the upload queue is full and new uploads are rejected. First step: run qvctl drain ingest-gateway and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 35 minutes, escalate to the Telemetry Platform team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

runbook-alert-router.title: Runbook: alert-router
runbook-alert-router.text:
## Purpose
The alert-router service decides which notification channel each alert goes to. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the routing lag in seconds stays above 700 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error ALR-8149 means alerts are stuck in the routing queue. First step: run qvctl flush-queue alert-router and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 60 minutes, escalate to the Alerting team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

runbook-billing-sync.title: Runbook: billing-sync
runbook-billing-sync.text:
## Purpose
The billing-sync service copies usage and invoices to the accounting system. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the count of unsynced invoices stays above 890 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error BIL-9379 means invoices fail to sync to the ledger. First step: run qvctl resync billing-sync and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 15 minutes, escalate to the Revenue Systems team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

runbook-device-registry.title: Runbook: device-registry
runbook-device-registry.text:
## Purpose
The device-registry service stores the identity and certificates of every device. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the certificate validation failures per minute stays above 940 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error DRG-2894 means device certificates fail validation. First step: run qvctl reload-certs device-registry and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 50 minutes, escalate to the Device Identity team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

runbook-report-builder.title: Runbook: report-builder
runbook-report-builder.text:
## Purpose
The report-builder service renders scheduled PDF and CSV reports. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the render time in seconds stays above 960 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error RPT-7311 means report rendering times out. First step: run qvctl restart report-builder and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 20 minutes, escalate to the Reporting team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

runbook-auth-broker.title: Runbook: auth-broker
runbook-auth-broker.text:
## Purpose
The auth-broker service issues login tokens for the web app and the API. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the token validation errors per minute stays above 870 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error AUT-4114 means token signing keys are out of sync. First step: run qvctl rotate-keys auth-broker and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 30 minutes, escalate to the Identity and Access team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

runbook-firmware-updater.title: Runbook: firmware-updater
runbook-firmware-updater.text:
## Purpose
The firmware-updater service pushes firmware updates to devices over the air. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the failed update percentage stays above 270 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error FWU-5173 means the update rollout has stalled. First step: run qvctl pause-rollout firmware-updater and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 40 minutes, escalate to the Fleet Operations team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

runbook-metrics-store.title: Runbook: metrics-store
runbook-metrics-store.text:
## Purpose
The metrics-store service stores time-series metrics. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the disk usage percentage stays above 480 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error MST-1727 means disk usage on the storage nodes is too high. First step: run qvctl compact metrics-store and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 25 minutes, escalate to the Storage team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

runbook-notification-hub.title: Runbook: notification-hub
runbook-notification-hub.text:
## Purpose
The notification-hub service sends e-mails, SMS and push notifications. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the SMS rejection rate percentage stays above 570 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error NTF-8144 means the SMS provider rejects messages. First step: run qvctl failover notification-hub and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 45 minutes, escalate to the Messaging team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

runbook-export-worker.title: Runbook: export-worker
runbook-export-worker.text:
## Purpose
The export-worker service produces bulk data exports for customers. This runbook is for the on-call engineer.

## Alerts
Page the on-call engineer when the pending export jobs stays above 100 for 10 minutes. Alerts are routed to the #oncall-platform channel.

## Known errors
Error EXP-1027 means export jobs are stuck in the pending state. First step: run qvctl requeue export-worker and watch the service dashboard for five minutes. Check recent deploys before restarting anything.

## Escalation
If the issue is not resolved within 10 minutes, escalate to the Data Products team. Record every action in the incident timeline.

release-7-0.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.0 release notes
release-7-0.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.0 is now available to all workspaces. New: Calibration Reminders, which reminds device owners when a sensor is due for calibration.

## Limits
The minimum dashboard auto-refresh interval in seconds was raised to 20. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

## Fixes
Fixed QC-4501: battery warnings were sent twice. Minor performance improvements across the web app.

release-7-1.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.1 release notes
release-7-1.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.1 is now available to all workspaces. New: Quiet Hours, which mutes non-critical notifications at night.

## Limits
The maximum number of rows per data export was raised to 1,000,000. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

## Fixes
Fixed QC-9375: SSO logins failed for users with long e-mail addresses. Minor performance improvements across the web app.

release-7-2.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.2 release notes
release-7-2.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.2 is now available to all workspaces. New: Shared Views, which shares a read-only dashboard link with people outside the workspace.

## Limits
The number of webhook retry attempts was raised to 6. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

## Fixes
Fixed QC-8752: device names with accents broke the PDF report. Minor performance improvements across the web app.

release-7-3.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.3 release notes
release-7-3.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.3 is now available to all workspaces. New: Floor Plans, which places devices on an uploaded building plan.

## Limits
The maximum number of alert rules per workspace was raised to 1,400. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

## Fixes
Fixed QC-3780: time zones were ignored in scheduled reports. Minor performance improvements across the web app.

release-7-4.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.4 release notes
release-7-4.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.4 is now available to all workspaces. New: Bulk Provisioning, which registers many devices at once from a CSV file.

## Limits
The maximum number of widgets per dashboard was raised to 84. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

## Fixes
Fixed QC-2389: CSV exports dropped the last row. Minor performance improvements across the web app.

release-7-5.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.5 release notes
release-7-5.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.5 is now available to all workspaces. New: Audit Export, which downloads the workspace audit log as a CSV file.

## Limits
The default API page size was raised to 200. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

## Fixes
Fixed QC-5649: deleted dashboards still appeared in search. Minor performance improvements across the web app.

release-7-6.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.6 release notes
release-7-6.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.6 is now available to all workspaces. New: Map Clustering, which groups nearby devices on the map view.

## Limits
The maximum number of saved filters per user was raised to 90. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

## Fixes
Fixed QC-9445: webhooks were not retried after a timeout. Minor performance improvements across the web app.

release-7-7.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.7 release notes
release-7-7.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.7 is now available to all workspaces. New: Webhook Signing, which signs every webhook with an HMAC header.

## Limits
The maximum number of recipients per scheduled report was raised to 30. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

## Fixes
Fixed QC-6491: chart tooltips showed the wrong unit. Minor performance improvements across the web app.

release-7-8.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.8 release notes
release-7-8.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.8 is now available to all workspaces. New: Data Gaps Report, which lists devices that stopped reporting.

## Limits
The number of map markers shown before clustering starts was raised to 200. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

## Fixes
Fixed QC-2530: the API returned 500 for empty filters. Minor performance improvements across the web app.

release-7-9.title: Quorvia Cloud 7.9 release notes
release-7-9.text:
## Highlights
Quorvia Cloud 7.9 is now available to all workspaces. New: Smart Baselines, which learns a normal range for each sensor and alerts on deviations.

## Limits
The maximum number of custom fields per device was raised to 80. Existing workspaces get the new limit automatically.

security-overview.title: Security overview
security-overview.text:
## Encryption
Customer data at rest is encrypted with AES-256 and data in transit uses TLS 1.2 or later. Encryption keys are rotated every 180 days.

## Assurance
Customers can request the SOC 2 Type II report through their account manager.

password-policy.title: Password and MFA policy
password-policy.text:
## Passwords
Passwords for company accounts must be at least 16 characters long. Passwords are not rotated on a schedule; they are changed after a suspected compromise.

## MFA
Multi-factor authentication with a hardware key or authenticator app is mandatory for all staff.

incident-severity.title: Incident severity levels
incident-severity.text:
## SEV1
SEV1 means a full outage for many customers. During a SEV1, status updates are posted every 30 minutes.

## SEV2
SEV2 means a major feature is degraded. During a SEV2, status updates are posted every 60 minutes.

## SEV3 and SEV4
SEV3 means a minor issue with a workaround; updates every 240 minutes. SEV4 is cosmetic; updates every 1440 minutes.

api-rate-limits.title: Quorvia Cloud API rate limits
api-rate-limits.text:
## Limits
The API allows 120 requests per minute on the Starter plan, 300 on the Team plan and 3000 on the Enterprise plan.

## Errors
Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

calibration-procedure.title: Sensor calibration procedure
calibration-procedure.text:
## Intervals
Pulse sensors are calibrated every 270 days, Tide sensors every 180 days, Ember loggers every 120 days and Vane sensors every 365 days.

## Procedure
Calibration is done with the reference kit and recorded in the device history.

procurement-policy.title: Procurement policy
procurement-policy.text:
## Quotes
Purchases above EUR 10,000 need three competing quotes.

## Approval
Purchase orders above EUR 100,000 need approval from the CFO.

onboarding-checklist.title: New joiner onboarding checklist
onboarding-checklist.text:
## First day
Laptops and badges are handed out on the first morning.

## First weeks
Security awareness training must be completed within 30 days of the start date.

firmware-compatibility.title: Firmware compatibility
firmware-compatibility.text:
## Minimum versions
Over-the-air updates require firmware 4.4 or later on the device.

## Support
Devices more than two major firmware versions behind are not supported.

installation-guide.title: Device installation guide
installation-guide.text:
## Placement
Mount Pulse sensors 1.5 metres above the floor, away from windows and vents.

## Gateways
One gateway hub connects up to 24 sensors.

brand-guidelines.title: Brand guidelines
brand-guidelines.text:
## Colour
The primary brand colour is #2E5E8C.

## Name
Always write Quorvia with a capital Q and never abbreviate it.

company-rituals.title: Company rituals
company-rituals.text:
## All-hands
The company all-hands meeting is held on the first Tuesday of every month.

## Offsite
The annual offsite takes place in May.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.text:
## Terms
A workspace is the top-level container for devices, dashboards and users. A site is a physical location inside a workspace. A gateway hub relays sensor readings to Quorvia Cloud.
